verdict.rationale: The evidence shows multi-currency balances, conversions, statements and webhook subscriptions, but nothing documents automatic top-ups between accounts or low-balance alerts. Webhooks and balance APIs are only building blocks a developer could use to construct such automation, so they earn no credit. The treasury axis applies to a business account product, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can automate cash management with auto top-up between accounts and low-balance alerts
